title: Colorado 2019-2020 sightings over missile silos

tellings.quote: I mean, the Colorado sightings, right, the 2019, 2020, those were uh over those nuclear missile silos partially, partially. And they mirrored 1965,

plain: In 2019 and 2020, unexplained objects were reported in the skies over Colorado, and some of them, Jesse Michels says, appeared over nuclear missile silos. Michels says this himself, without naming a source, and adds that the sightings "mirrored 1965," an earlier wave over the same kind of site. If true, it would suggest that whatever is being seen keeps coming back to America's nuclear weapons.
